featured_title: Will You Lose Your Citizens Policy on January 1, 2027? Southwest Florida 2026
featured_excerpt: Citizens Property Insurance has been phasing in a flood insurance requirement since 2023, and the last step lands on January 1, 2027, when it applies to all policies regardless of dwelling value. The date that controls you is your renewal date, not January 1.
